The Numerical 80 — every figure worked out

Eighty questions that turn on arithmetic, each with a step-by-step solution and a note on where every wrong option comes from. Grouped into nine blocks, from the 285-day buffer to the study-leave walls.

80 questions
How to use this page. Try each question with the solution closed. The moment you are unsure, open it: the three steps are written the way an establishment clerk would work the file — test the limit, do the arithmetic, then apply the ceiling. The last line tells you which mistake produces each wrong option, because that is what you are actually being tested on.

Settings and sources

What is in this file, where each figure comes from, and what is deliberately left out.

Read this before you rely on a figure

This is a study aid, not a consolidated statute and not legal advice. The bare text follows the DoPT consolidation updated 24 September 2024, and the exam figures follow the study guide supplied with this build. Where the rules and a later O.M. differ, the O.M. governs to the extent of the difference. Casual leave, special casual leave, compensatory leave and restricted holidays are executive instructions, not rules — this platform labels them as such on every card. Verify any operative figure against the bare rules before using it in an office order.

What is in this file

Data and privacy

Everything runs offline in the browser. Your answers, bookmarks, flashcards and mock results live in this browser's local storage and never leave the device. Use Export to keep a copy and Import to move it to another machine.

Source map

Bare rule textCCS (Leave) Rules, 1972 as consolidated by DoPT, edition updated 24.09.2024 — reproduced rule by rule, with the guide's clause-level annotations.
Key figuresRules 26, 27, 29, 30, 31, 32, 38, 38-A, 39 to 39-D, 43 to 43-C, 44, 49, 50 to 63; cross-checked against the amendment register below.
Amendment datesDoPT and MoF notifications listed in the amendment register (18.04.2002, 15/16.01.2004, 11.09.2008, 22.07.2009, 11.12.2018, 30.08.2019 and others).
Non-statutory leaveDoPT O.M.s and the Leave Brochure (CL 8 days, SCL heads, comp-off, RH 2 days) — labelled non-statutory wherever they appear.
Deliberately excludedState rules, Railway and All India Services leave rules, FR/CSR staff, and anything decided only by an individual office order. Rule 2 excludes them from this rule-book.
